product.title: Anker 543 USB C to USB C Cable (240W, 10 ft)
product.description: Built with Bio-Based Nylon: 46% of the exterior of the cable body and the connector casing is made from bio-based nylon. Using bio-based nylon in our cables allows us to cut down on petroleum-based plastic such as TPE. Fast Charging: Charge a Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra to 65% in just 30 minutes. Built to Last: Designed to withstand up to 10,000 bends, and proven to resist fraying and kinking even after being tested 10,000 times. Wide Compatibility: Meets USB-IF safety standards for flawless compatibility with virtually any USB-C device, including phones, tablets, laptops, and more. What You Get: Anker 543 USB-C to USB-C Cable (Bio-Nylon 10ft), our worry-free 24-month warranty, and friendly customer service.
